openai/gpt-5.6-sol.title: CRC-16-CCITT starts at 0x0000 instead of the required 0xFFFF.
MAX_PAYLOAD admits 65536 bytes although the contract permits at most 65535.
A partial frame with a complete header is sliced using its declared length before verifying that the payload and trailer are buffered.
A checksum mismatch is reported as Ok(None) instead of surfacing FrameError.
Checksum recovery consumes the entire declared frame instead of resynchronizing at the next magic sequence.
drain silently discards every malformed-frame error returned by next_frame.
Resynchronization discards a trailing 0xA5 byte that may be the first byte of a magic sequence split across feeds.
Oversize-frame recovery skips the whole header and can discard the next magic sequence when it begins inside the rejected length field.
After malformed bytes leave the drain budget stale, a reentrant feed can make drain process new data and underflow its budget.
The public consume method adds an unchecked caller-controlled count to read_pos and can wrap the cursor.
Feeding after repeated next_frame calls never compacts a consumed prefix when a partial suffix remains, allowing the backing vector to grow without bound.
